# artifactkeeper_plugin (Resource)

Installs a WASM plugin from a git repository and manages its enabled state and configuration. Only git-sourced plugins are supported; zip/local uploads and reload are imperative actions outside Terraform's model. The backend does not return the install source on read, so changing `source_git_url` or `source_git_ref` forces a reinstall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Install a WASM format plugin from git, enabled, with config.
resource "artifactkeeper_plugin" "cyclonedx" {
  source_git_url = "https://github.com/artifact-keeper/plugin-cyclonedx.git"
  source_git_ref = "v1.2.0"
  enabled        = true

  config = jsonencode({
    strict_mode = true
    max_depth   = 5
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is enabled (active). Set to `false` to install but keep the plugin disabled.
- `source_git_url` (String) Git repository URL to install the plugin from. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `config` (String) Plugin configuration as a JSON object string (use `jsonencode(...)`). Omit to leave the plugin's config unmanaged.
- `source_git_ref` (String) Git ref (tag, branch, or commit) to install. Defaults to the repository default branch. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `author` (String) Plugin author, if declared.
- `config_schema` (String) The plugin's declared config JSON schema, if any.
- `description` (String) Plugin description, if any.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable plugin name.
- `enabled_at` (String) When the plugin was last enabled (RFC 3339), if ever.
- `format_key` (String) Format key the plugin registers, if it is a format plugin. Known only at install time.
- `homepage` (String) Plugin homepage, if declared.
- `id` (String) Plugin UUID.
- `installed_at` (String) When the plugin was installed (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) Plugin name.
- `plugin_type` (String) Plugin type (e.g. `format`, `validator`).
- `status` (String) Backend plugin status (`active`, `disabled`, `error`).
- `version` (String) Installed plugin version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Plugins import by UUID. source_git_url/ref and format_key are not returned by
# the API, so add them to configuration after import; the next plan reconciles.
terraform import artifactkeeper_plugin.cyclonedx 0e1f2a3b-4c5d-6e7f-8091-a2b3c4d5e6f7
```
